note: XXVII Q2 new Midjourney takes (Ian, 22 Nov 2:18 a.m.): good images, but the smoke comes from her mouth and the mark is off to the side. Step 1, before any smoke rendering: smoke out, the cross within a circle moved to the centre of the forehead.

people.mina: Mina Harker with the cross-within-a-circle scar in the centre of her forehead, as in the reference

beats.text: Remove ALL the smoke and vapour from the picture, especially the smoke coming from her mouth, so the sunset sky around her is clean. Remove the mark now on her forehead and paint instead, exactly in the centre of her forehead just above the eyebrows, the mark shown in the reference portrait: a small dark-red scar of an equal-armed cross set within a thin circle, clearly a cross inside a ring, like a seared brand. Keep her face, expression, eyes, hair, scarf, light and background exactly as they are.
